dict.string: Experience a thoroughly modernised app with better performance and new features for backups, refunds and managing your transactions.
The app is built on a completely new architecture, delivering better performance and new animations.
The backup system has been completely redesigned, with the option to also back up your data to iCloud Drive on Apple devices.
Support for iPhone Duo has been added, including a design fully optimised for its layout.
You can now create refunds directly from existing transactions with a swipe gesture or through the context menu.
You can now mark currencies as favourites to find them even faster in the currency list.
When editing multiple transactions, you can easily select or deselect them all at once. In shared budget books, you can also change the assigned person for multiple transactions at the same time.
The filter view now makes it easy to search for categories and other entries, and to specifically find recurring transactions through the global search.
More readable amounts, category icons in the pie chart, emoji search, new display options for categories and tags and simpler onboarding.
